scope: One cfg(unix) attribute on the existing Unix-only test helper; no shipping code or function body change.

external_jobs.label: staged-source-llvm-whole-v6
external_jobs.qualification: Per-job source/log identity only; native assertions, profiles, executables and unrelated dirty files are not independently re-attested or added as extra unique tests.

current_whole_suite_association.file_summary_qualification: Native files[] summary availability is distinct from functions[] CodeRegion availability. Missing integration file summaries do not erase actual function-record entries or grant line coverage.
current_whole_suite_association.job_source_binding_qualification: All13 exact retained census paths have matching actual v6 before/after job pins. Runner hash and required path list are also independently checked; executable before/after remains un-attested by this receipt.
limits: Positive is any actual matching first regular CodeRegion count>0; function/signature totals, physical-line segments and nearby closure/generated entries never substitute for a different executable header.

Exact physical native filename plus source declaration line and UTF8 byte column binds each ordered lexical occurrence. Every native monomorphization/alias instance, zero and unmapped row remains visible.

Entry observations do not establish full function-body, line, branch, MC/DC, platform or acceptance coverage. Source/cfg/method qualification remains lexical rather than compiler-complete AST resolution.
Native whole-file/export summaries include production, tests, generated and anonymous records from the new whole-suite instrumented targets only; they are not whole-repository production metrics.
The v6 job verifies all13 Rust before/after source pins, required path list, runner hash and actual log identity. No inferred executable before/after, profile provenance or native/browser acceptance.
Historical319 is not added. Own Store/source-code correctness, native/browser/human/AT/platform/hosted/release/fullS6/final-doc acceptance are excluded.

normal_binary_observation.qualification: Root-provided observation only; this job does not pin binaries before/after and this association does not use the normal binary or attest final executable provenance.
